title: Aetheria Wave A Canonical Pet Roster
purpose: Versioned canonical Wave A content roster: 55 active identities (the frozen 43-Pet Wave 1 catalog plus six dragon and six bird species-family members) and an additive six-Pet S off-rate candidate layer that stays acquisition-gated until an owner banner decision, reaching 61 identities. Presentation power class is recorded separately from catalog rank, summon rarity, acquisition authority and gameplay readiness. The frozen 43-Pet catalog and the Wave 1 gacha pool are unchanged.

authority.note: Identity, element, family/morphology, source category, presentation class and asset mapping only. It grants no gameplay balance, stats, acquisition, banner, model production, rights, Unity admission, publication or spending authority. Wave 1 remains DRAFT_ONLY / OFFLINE_ONLY / NO_GO_PUBLIC.
authority.frozenCatalogMutation: NONE: specs/pet-arena/mvp-wave1-43-pets.json, apps/platform-api/src/features/pets/modules/wave1/domain/catalog.ts and the featured/standard gacha pool are read-only inputs to this roster.

assignment.standard_gacha: A presentation (owner direction, label "A · Standard"); catalog rank and summon rarity stay Standard S
assignment.s_offrate_candidate: S (label "S · Off-rate", summon rarity "Standard S off-rate")
assignment.shared_race_base: B (label "B · Race base"); bodies, not collectible Pets, excluded from every count above

powerClassModel.note: The six original Standard-S summons read A while their summon rarity stays Standard S: rank, rarity, acquisition and presentation class are independent fields on every entry. The S off-rate candidate layer contributes S presentation class only; it contributes no acquisition and no gameplay presence.

decisions.decision: 43 frozen Wave 1 identities plus 12 dragon/bird family members are ACTIVE canonical Pets (55). The six S off-rate concepts are an additive CANDIDATE layer (61 total), not part of the active roster and not acquisition-enabled.
decisions.rationale: The frozen 43-Pet lock and the families-v3 / concepts-v4 batches are separate source scopes; the candidate layer needs an owner banner decision before it can become active.

decisions.topic: Presentation power class vs gameplay data
decisions.decision: Dragons are presentation Power Class S and birds are A. Presentation class is stored only in presentationPowerClass / presentationClassLabel. catalogRank, summonRarity, acquisitionAuthority, gachaRole and the runtime-ready flags stay separate fields and are never derived from the class.
decisions.rationale: power-tiers-mvp-wave1.md defines a presentation ladder explicitly separate from stats, summon rarity and acquisition. The six Standard-S summons prove the separation: rank S, rarity Standard S, class A.

decisions.topic: Shared race bases are not collectible Pets
decisions.decision: The 10 shared race bases are modelled as WaveARaceBase entries with collectible:false and are excluded from the 55/61 counts. Map-regular Pets reference them only through baseMeshId.
decisions.rationale: The race bases are modular bodies reused by six element variants, not Pet identities; power-tiers labels them B as bodies, not as roster members.

decisions.decision: One stable ID: pet-s-ground-jaderyx, canonical display name Jaderyx, alias Jadewarden, source category s_offrate_candidate. No pet-s-ground-jadewarden ID is minted. See namingConflicts[0].
decisions.rationale: The generated concept, its PNG filename, the concepts-v4 canonicalId and the CDN object key all use Jaderyx. Minting a second ID for a display-name variant would create a duplicate collectible identity.

decisions.decision: Frozen Wave 1 identities keep their existing IDs unchanged; the 12 family members keep the families-v3 canonicalId form dragon-<element>-<name> / bird-<element>-<name>; the six candidates keep the concepts-v4 canonicalId form pet-s-<element>-<name>.
decisions.rationale: Every ID already keys an existing ledger, CDN object or runtime catalog entry; renaming would orphan assets and runtime references.

decisions.decision: The roster uses exactly the six frozen elements fire, water, electric, ghost, ground and light. The dragon and bird families add no element, and each family covers all six exactly once; the candidate layer adds one identity per element.
decisions.rationale: art-bible-families-dragon-bird.md locks the six-element system: the tide dragon stays Water and the void dragon is Ghost; there is no Ice or Dark element.

decisions.decision: The frozen 43 keep acquisitionAuthority FROZEN_WAVE1_RULES (unchanged featured identity and six-entry standard off-rate pool). The 12 family members have no acquisition rule (NONE_OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED). The six candidates are BLOCKED_OWNER_BANNER_DECISION.
decisions.rationale: No source defines summon or capture rules for the family batch, and the candidate batch is explicitly not approved for release; inventing a rule would imply unowned design authority.

decisions.decision: Every concept reference points at an existing committed CDN manifest key with matching sha256 and bytes. No image was generated, renamed, uploaded or removed. Model, rig, animation and VFX gaps are explicit per identity instead of being left blank.
decisions.rationale: The task forbids regeneration and requires missing asset states to be explicit; the CDN manifest is the only asset-metadata authority in the repository.

decisions.decision: Only the frozen 43 carry a mapId. The 12 family members and the six candidates have mapId null and change no PvE encounter table.
decisions.rationale: Wave 1 map membership is locked by the 43-Pet specification; placing new identities on maps would silently alter campaign content and reward pacing.

decisions.topic: No silent mutation of frozen data
decisions.decision: specs/pet-arena/mvp-wave1-43-pets.json, domain/catalog.ts (WAVE1_PETS, starters, rewards), domain/manifest.ts (featured identity and standard pool) and the Wave 1 rules hash are untouched; the runtime roster is a new module and its tests assert the frozen 43 still match their own specification.
decisions.rationale: The frozen catalog and gacha pool are the live runtime contract; a content roster must add a layer, not rewrite it.

namingConflicts.subject: Ground S off-rate candidate: Jadewarden vs Jaderyx
namingConflicts.decision: pet-s-ground-jaderyx is the only stable ID. Jaderyx is the canonical display name. Jadewarden remains a lookup alias and must never become a second Pet ID, CDN key or gacha entry.
namingConflicts.rationale: The concept ledger, PNG filename and CDN object are all keyed to Jaderyx, and the asset may not be regenerated or renamed. The Jadewarden rows are the stale side of the drift.
followUps: Owner may restore the display name Jadewarden later; the stable ID pet-s-ground-jaderyx does not change.
The owning spec owner should correct power-tiers-mvp-wave1.md section 3 and power-tiers-mvp-wave1.json rules[2]; this catalog does not edit those source specs.

findings.finding: Coverage is complete and non-duplicated: six candidates, one per element, six distinct archetypes and six distinct regalia languages; the large/small split is 3/3.
findings.evidence: concepts-v4 assets 1-6 plus power-tiers-mvp-wave1.md section 6 and concepts-v4 scaleSplit.

findings.finding: The rejected shared three-ring regalia pass is not present in the current concepts: each candidate carries its own regalia, and the rejected pass cost 9 corrective regenerations at zero paid credits.
findings.evidence: concepts-v4 revisionHistory and quotaAccounting (15 free images for 6 concepts, paidBalance unchanged at 1910).

findings.finding: Solenne is not a batch-generated concept: it is owner-provided replacement art stored outside the repository, and its rights stay PENDING_REVIEW. It must not be treated as a production reference or a rights-cleared asset.
findings.evidence: concepts-v4 assets[5] sourceFile /home/tiecont/Downloads/cao-chin-duoi.webp, generatedInBatch false, replacement true, rights PENDING_REVIEW.

findings.finding: The ground candidate has two display names across sources (Jadewarden / Jaderyx) and the stale side also shows a non-existent ID pet-s-ground-jadewarden.
findings.evidence: namingConflicts[0]; power-tiers-mvp-wave1.md section 3 vs section 6 and JSON entries[4].

findings.finding: Candidate metadata drifts between ledgers: power-tiers-mvp-wave1.json omits the archetype for Vulcaryn, Fulgarys and Solenne, while concepts-v4 records an archetype for all six. This roster takes archetype from concepts-v4.
findings.evidence: power-tiers-mvp-wave1.json entries 1, 3 and 6 have no archetype field.

findings.finding: No candidate identity exists in gameplay: none appears in the frozen 43-Pet catalog, the featured banner or the six-entry standard off-rate pool, and no model, rig, animation or VFX asset exists for any of the six.
findings.evidence: domain/catalog.ts WAVE1_PETS, domain/manifest.ts GACHA_FEATURED / GACHA_STANDARD_POOL, CDN manifest contains concept PNGs only.

findings.finding: Concept approval is not recorded for any candidate; the batch ownerReview requires APPROVE / REVISE / REJECT per concept and states productionApproval false.
findings.evidence: concepts-v4 ownerReview and six null ownerDecision fields.

findings.finding: The candidate layer uses "S" for two independent concepts: presentation Power Class S and summon rarity "Standard S off-rate". They are stored in separate fields and must not be collapsed in UI or data contracts.
findings.evidence: power-tiers-mvp-wave1.json entries[0-5] carry both powerClass S and summonRarity "Standard S off-rate".

gachaFrozen.note: Re-exported from the frozen manifest for reconciliation only. This catalog adds no banner, no pool member and no rate, and the six candidates are not eligible for either pool.

missingAssets.policy: Only existing assets are referenced. Nothing was generated, renamed, uploaded, migrated or regenerated by this catalog.

model.note: No Wave A Pet has an admitted game model or prefab. Icarus has Unity art-study files (apps/unity-client/Assets/Aetheria/ArtStudies/Icarus: VRM, FBX, GLB accessories, review prefab) recorded as ART_STUDY_EXISTS_NOT_ADMITTED; they are not a Wave 1 Pet model and not an admission.

rig.note: The 43 frozen identities name a rig profile (for example rig_humanoid) but no rigged Pet asset exists. The 12 family members and six candidates have no rig family assigned.

animation.note: No animation clip exists in the Unity client for any Wave A Pet identity (no .anim assets under apps/unity-client/Assets/Aetheria); only the Icarus art-study review Animator controller exists.

vfx.note: No Pet VFX asset exists for a Wave A identity; element palettes and aura motifs are concept-stage only.

concept.note: The 30 map-regular Pets have no individual concept PNG; the shared race-base concept is their only existing art. The 10 race-base concepts are referenced through WaveARaceBase and are not Pet concepts.

cdn.note: The committed manifest contains no model, rig, animation or VFX binary of any kind. Its counts are asserted by the unit test.

cdn.note: Every concept reference is an existing key in this manifest with matching sha256 and bytes. The roster references all 41 committed images (31 Pet concepts plus 10 race-base concepts) and no other file.

validationInvariants: Exactly 61 unique roster IDs: 55 ACTIVE plus 6 CANDIDATE, with no duplicate ID, name or alias collision.
ACTIVE composition is 43 core Wave 1 identities plus 6 dragon plus 6 bird identities.
Exactly six elements are used; each of the dragon, bird and candidate layers covers all six exactly once.
Presentation power classes are S 13 / A 24 / B 18 for the 55 active identities and S 19 / A 24 / B 18 for the 61 identities; dragons are S and birds are A.
Presentation power class is stored separately from catalog rank, summon rarity, acquisition authority and runtime-ready flags.
The 10 shared race bases are non-collectible, are excluded from the counts and no race-base ID appears in the roster.
The six S off-rate candidates are CANDIDATE, acquisition-blocked, absent from both gacha pools and not gameplay-ready.
Exactly one stable ground-candidate ID exists (pet-s-ground-jaderyx) with Jadewarden recorded as an alias only.
Every concept reference resolves to an existing CDN manifest key with matching sha256 and bytes; no asset was generated or renamed.
Model, rig, animation and VFX status is explicit on every identity; nothing claims an admitted production asset.
The frozen 43-Pet catalog, the featured identity, the six-entry standard pool and the Wave 1 rules hash are unchanged.
No validation result may promote acquisition, banner eligibility, rights, publication or gameplay for any identity.
